purpose: Preserved research from projects outside the current Community Ledger catalogue.

matches.fit_reason: A locally led preparedness and information-sharing project aligns strongly if it addresses a specific climate or disaster risk.
matches.eligibility_status: TO BE CONFIRMED: eligible local not-for-profit, defined climate or disaster risk, community leadership and only one SRC stream
evidence_needed: confirmed legal applicant and authority to apply
grant-specific eligible scope, budget and quotes
local need, delivery plan and measurable outcomes
site, cultural, rights, safety or partner permissions where relevant
matches.cofunding_plan: Use this community preparedness to unlock later delivery grants, resident or member fundraising, local sponsorship, visitor giving and philanthropy, eligible applicant cash, earned income and verified in-kind support. Every layer is unconfirmed until evidenced.
matches.qualifying_reframe: Select one risk, community cohort and practical preparedness outcome rather than a broad resilience brand.
matches.next_move: Use FRRR for community capability and small equipment; council Get Ready funds require a separate authorised council route.
human_roles: Community, subject-matter and financial reviewers appropriate to the scope
ai_tasks: Maintain the official-source and eligibility checklist
Prepare the evidence register, budget worksheet and deadline brief for human review
Flag unsupported claims, missing authority, duplicated costs and source changes
matches.readiness_check: Confirm applicant, hazard evidence, local leadership, emergency-service boundaries, delivery plan and measures.

matches.fit_reason: A broad resilience umbrella can fit only after it selects a specific climate risk and community-led response.
matches.eligibility_status: TO BE CONFIRMED: eligible local not-for-profit, defined climate risk, community leadership and only one SRC stream
evidence_needed: confirmed legal applicant and authority to apply
grant-specific eligible scope, budget and quotes
local need, delivery plan and measurable outcomes
site, cultural, rights, safety or partner permissions where relevant
matches.cofunding_plan: This community resilience delivery can be combined with memberships, ticket or earned income where eligible, resident fundraising, local sponsor cash or in-kind support, visitor giving, philanthropy and later program grants. Every layer is unconfirmed until evidenced.
matches.qualifying_reframe: Choose one island-wide preparedness or recovery capability with practical deliverables and local leadership.
matches.next_move: Use FRRR for community capability; use ARENA for large electrification only and Get Ready only through Council.
human_roles: Community, subject-matter and financial reviewers appropriate to the scope
ai_tasks: Maintain the official-source and eligibility checklist
Prepare the evidence register, budget worksheet and deadline brief for human review
Flag unsupported claims, missing authority, duplicated costs and source changes
matches.readiness_check: Confirm applicant, risk evidence, local leadership, delivery plan and one SRC stream choice.

matches.fit_reason: Energy resilience could fit only as a large consumer-energy demonstration with experienced delivery and finance.
matches.eligibility_status: TO BE CONFIRMED: ARP eligibility, proven consortium, finance, roughly 1,000-home scale, innovation and community engagement
evidence_needed: confirmed legal applicant and authority to apply
grant-specific eligible scope, budget and quotes
local need, delivery plan and measurable outcomes
site, cultural, rights, safety or partner permissions where relevant
matches.funding_ask: ARENA aims for at least $4 million per selected jurisdictional demonstration
matches.cofunding_plan: Use this energy-resilience demonstration to unlock later delivery grants, resident or member fundraising, local sponsorship, visitor giving and philanthropy, eligible applicant cash, earned income and verified in-kind support. Every layer is unconfirmed until evidenced.
matches.qualifying_reframe: Define scalable household electrification, storage, orchestration and equity outcomes rather than general resilience.
matches.next_move: Use smaller grants for preparedness; ARENA is a later consortium-scale capital and innovation pathway.
human_roles: Community, subject-matter and financial reviewers appropriate to the scope
ai_tasks: Maintain the official-source and eligibility checklist
Prepare the evidence register, budget worksheet and deadline brief for human review
Flag unsupported claims, missing authority, duplicated costs and source changes
matches.readiness_check: Map technical, network, finance, community and governance requirements without implying partner assent.

matches.fit_reason: A community-controlled digital-twin service may fit only if an established First Nations-owned business chooses and governs the project. The current public prototype has not been reviewed by Traditional Owners.
matches.eligibility_status: TO BE CONFIRMED: First Nations ownership and authority, established business, community purpose, data governance, product scope and delivery capability
evidence_needed: First Nations-owned project and decision rights
community-chosen public and restricted data rules
defined product, users and benefits
business, technical, privacy, budget and milestone evidence
matches.funding_ask: Advisory services and possible grants up to $100,000
matches.cofunding_plan: An authorised project could combine this pathway with member or resident fundraising, local sponsorship, philanthropy, earned service income and verified in-kind data, technical or site support. Every layer is unconfirmed until evidenced.
matches.qualifying_reframe: Offer the prototype as optional research material for a First Nations-controlled team to accept, change or reject while defining its own service and data rules.
matches.next_move: Do not present the prototype as community-controlled yet; first confirm whether an eligible First Nations-owned lead wants to govern a defined digital-twin service.
human_roles: First Nations project and data authority
Community, cultural, privacy, technical and financial reviewers
ai_tasks: Prepare a blank governance and data-classification framework
Map applicant and product evidence for human review
Flag any implied Traditional Owner approval or ownership
matches.readiness_check: Confirm First Nations ownership, authority, applicant status, community-defined purpose, data rights, privacy, product scope, capability, budget and milestones.

matches.fit_reason: No verified current grant match is retained for this project. Locally researched fundraising or in-kind help could support one small community media or digital-skills pilot, subject to human review. This is not an open grant, confirmed supporter or funding commitment.
matches.eligibility_status: TO BE CONFIRMED: authorised project lead, lawful fundraising or sponsorship structure, project scope, rights, cultural authority where relevant, budget and explicit permission before naming or contacting supporters
evidence_needed: authorised lead and bounded public-benefit scope
lawful fundraising or sponsorship structure and evidenced budget
rights, cultural authority, site, insurance and safety evidence where relevant
explicit supporter assent before any involvement is described as agreed
matches.stack_role: research-only local fundraising and in-kind support
matches.funding_ask: No grant amount or committed support — develop an evidenced budget first
matches.cofunding_plan: Possible resident or member fundraising, local sponsorship, philanthropy, lawful earned income and in-kind support remain entirely unsecured. Verify permissions, costs and any future grant separately; avoid duplicate funding.
matches.qualifying_reframe: Only if an authorised lead confirms real community need and feasibility, explore one small community media or digital-skills pilot. Do not treat this as evidence of a registered co-op, employer or training organisation.
matches.next_move: Review the preserved project scope and readiness evidence with an authorised lead. Research possible local fundraising, sponsorship and in-kind support, but do not contact anyone, name supporters as committed or revive the expired grant round without new verified evidence.
human_roles: Authorised project lead and budget decision-maker
Relevant artists, facilitators, site or rights holders for the defined pilot
Safety, accessibility, cultural-authority and financial reviewers where relevant

Research possible local support without contacting anyone or implying assent
Flag unsupported authority, rights, community demand, operating status or funding claims
matches.readiness_check: Confirm an authorised project lead, lawful operating structure, defined participants, trainer or facilitator, media rights, privacy, equipment access, budget and delivery capacity. Check the lawful basis for any fundraising; obtain explicit assent before describing anyone as involved. No contact or application is authorised by this record.
